title: Amendment
description: Immutable change record in the Shapes Specification. Captures who changed what, why, and with what impact. Once created, amendments are append-only — they are never modified or deleted.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this amendment.

description.description: Prose description of what was changed and why.

targets.description: The set of nodes affected by this amendment. At least one target array must be present and non-empty.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this amendment (e.g. proposed, canonical).

version_impact.description: Semantic versioning impact level of this change on its targets.

intent.description: Structured declaration of what this amendment is meant to achieve and why.

constraints.description: References to Constraint nodes that govern or were introduced by this amendment.

realization.description: Bindings that map this amendment to concrete change artifacts (commits, PRs, etc.).

evidence.description: Verification records proving that this amendment was applied correctly.

provenance.description: Origin and authorship records for this amendment.

initiated_by.description: Identity and context of the actor who initiated this amendment.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to this amendment.

AmendmentTargets.title: AmendmentTargets
AmendmentTargets.description: Specifies which nodes are affected by an amendment. All fields are optional, but at least one array must be present and non-empty for the amendment to be valid. This invariant is enforced at the application level since JSON Schema cannot express cross-field 'at least one non-empty' constraints cleanly.

shape_ids.description: Shape IDs targeted by this amendment.

constraint_ids.description: Constraint IDs targeted by this amendment.

profile_ids.description: Profile IDs targeted by this amendment.

InitiatedBy.title: InitiatedBy
InitiatedBy.description: Identity of the actor who initiated an amendment.

identity.description: Identifier for the specific actor (e.g. username, agent name, service account).

provenance.description: URI or description of the context in which this actor initiated the amendment.
